ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Medicaid Funding Freeze
ideas.description: An investigation into the federal decision to freeze Medicaid funding in Minnesota and its impact on healthcare services.
questions: What is the impact of the funding freeze on healthcare services in Minnesota?
How will the state appeal the decision?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger issue with government funding and potentially indicate a pattern of mismanagement.

ideas.title: Trump Administration's Handling of Immigration Detention
ideas.description: An investigation into the Trump administration's handling of immigration detention, particularly with regards to children.
questions: What are the conditions like in immigration detention centers?
Is the administration attempting to prolong the detention of children?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger issue with the administration's handling of immigration detention and potentially indicate a pattern of misconduct.
